title: Higgsfield wrapper payload
description: Schema for input to hf_gen_with_sidecar.sh. Validates SHAPE only; runtime validator enforces path canonicalization, model recency, and Soul Character account-match.

model.description: Higgsfield job_set_type; runtime validator checks against current `higgsfield model list --json` snapshot

resolution.description: Image models use 1k/2k/4k. Video models (Seedance, Kling, Veo) use 480p/720p/1080p. Platform rejects mismatches per model.

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. Only meaningful for video models (Seedance, Kling, Veo). Common values: 5, 8, 10. Platform rejects unsupported values per model.

mode.description: Generation mode for video models (e.g. pro for higher resolution). Passed as --mode to the CLI.

genre.description: Cinematic genre register for Seedance 2.0. Influences pacing, lighting, motion register. Passed as --genre to the CLI. Default 'auto'.

wait_timeout_seconds.description: Override wrapper default (180s for image, 600s recommended for video)

skip_sidecar.description: When true, wrapper writes the asset directly to the gallery DB (vc_gallery) instead of emitting a legacy .md sidecar. Recommended for all new gens — the dashboard is the truth, sidecars become clutter. Existing sidecars stay readable; this only governs new ones.

gallery.description: Absolute path to gallery folder. Runtime validator ensures it canonicalizes under $VC_GALLERY_ROOT (no escapes via .. or symlinks).

filename.description: Basename only. Pattern rejects path separators, leading dots, control chars, NUL. Extension allowlist enforces image/video output types.

client.description: Client identifier. Matches canonical client folder name under clients/ (e.g. BTW_Documentary, Malcolm-Callux). Pattern relaxed 2026-05-15 to allow uppercase + underscore-prefixed names — studio canonical names are not lowercase slugs.

project.description: Project identifier (e.g. Episode_9, Pilot, Sevensight_Hero). Pattern relaxed 2026-05-15 to allow uppercase + underscore-prefixed names.

workflow.description: Must match VALID_WORKFLOWS in write_companion_note.py. Runtime validator imports VALID_WORKFLOWS at validate-time and asserts this enum stays in sync.

image.description: Source image(s): a single string OR an array of strings (1-8). Each element is either a local absolute path (auto-uploaded by CLI) or a pre-uploaded media UUID. For multi-ref workflows (face-swap, identity transfer, multi-angle composition), pass an ARRAY — wrapper passes one --image flag per element to the higgsfield CLI. Runtime validator: if path, must canonicalize under client/project asset roots.

start_image.description: For image-to-video first frame. String OR array (rare, but allowed for multi-ref video models). Each element: local path (auto-uploaded by CLI) or pre-uploaded UUID or https URL.

end_image.description: For image-to-video last frame. String OR array.

video.description: Source video for video-to-video / lipsync / restyle workflows. String OR array (e.g. multi-clip stitch). Local path (auto-uploaded), UUID, or https URL.

audio.description: Source audio for lipsync / VO-driven video models. String OR array. Local path, UUID, or https URL.

soul_id.description: Pre-trained Soul Character reference ID. Use this OR soul_name, not both.

soul_name.description: Friendly name resolved against clients/<client>/soul_refs.yaml. Runtime validator: lookup must succeed AND stored account_id must match active workspace_id.

pass_num.description: Iteration counter; same field as canonical writer's pass

shot_id.description: Shot identifier. Canonical form is SH<digits>[A-Za-z]{0,4} (e.g. SH1430, SH050C, SH040ABC). Also accepts free-text identifiers for drafts/experiments (e.g. TEST, RND_dreamscape, cref_a) or empty string. Pattern relaxed 2026-05-15 to support exploratory work.

session.description: Session UUID — wrapper auto-detects if omitted

session_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; wrapper auto-fills today if omitted

notes.description: Short why-this-exists note; survives to sidecar frontmatter

refs.description: Wikilinks or URLs to reference material; appears in sidecar refs[]

extra_tags.description: Lowercase tags appended to sidecar tags[]; model/workflow/client/project auto-added by canonical writer

force.description: Override existing-file collision (skips O_EXCL reservation conflict)

quality.description: Output quality. Supported by gpt_image_2. Defaults to high.

allOf.description: soul_id and soul_name are mutually exclusive
